smart_shade.title: Configure Smart Tracking Shade
smart_shade.description: Configure solar tracking geometry, automated closing schedule, and battery monitoring.

data.name: Integration Name
data.enable_tilt_intercept: Intercept Low Percentage Commands for Tilt (1-10%)

data_description.name: Friendly name to identify this shade or group in Home Assistant.
data_description.target_cover: The physical cover entity representing the shade motor.
data_description.window_direction: Compass direction the window faces. Sun tracking activates when sunlight enters this orientation.
data_description.azimuth_tolerance: Acceptance angle half-width (degrees) around the window heading where sunlight enters.
data_description.elevation_low_threshold: Minimum solar elevation above the horizon required for automated solar tracking.
data_description.elevation_high_threshold: Maximum solar elevation before the sun is too high to directly enter the window.
data_description.tracking_start_time: Earliest time of day to permit automated tracking adjustments.
data_description.tracking_end_time: Latest time of day before solar tracking adjustments stop.
data_description.position_change_sensitivity: Minimum percentage position change required before moving the shade.
data_description.position_offset: Fixed percentage offset applied to the computed solar shade position.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather entity. When conditions are overcast or rainy, solar tracking pauses.
data_description.travel_time_seconds: Full open-to-close transit duration in seconds for movement timing.
data_description.enable_override_timeout: Automatically revert to automated tracking after a manual shade adjustment.
data_description.override_timeout_minutes: Minutes to pause automatic tracking following manual interaction.
data_description.enable_auto_close: Automatically close shade every evening at the scheduled time.
data_description.auto_close_time: Scheduled evening time to close the shade.
data_description.enable_auto_open: Automatically open shade every morning at the scheduled time.
data_description.auto_open_time: Scheduled morning time to open the shade.
data_description.auto_open_position: Target position percentage for the scheduled morning opening.
data_description.enable_tilt_intercept: Intercept small position commands (1-10%) and convert them into slat tilt commands.
data_description.tilt_intercept_threshold: Maximum position percentage threshold treated as a tilt adjustment command.
data_description.battery_sensor: Optional sensor reporting raw battery voltage or percentage.
data_description.battery_mode: Whether the raw sensor reports voltage (V) or direct percentage (%).
data_description.battery_min: Nominal minimum reading representing empty battery (0%).
data_description.battery_max: Nominal maximum reading representing full charge (100%).
data_description.battery_auto_learn: Automatically expand calibration limits if observed readings exceed current min/max.
data_description.battery_low_threshold: Battery percentage threshold triggering low-battery diagnostics and notifications.
data_description.hide_underlying: Automatically hide physical shade entities from dashboards and voice assistants.
